snippet.title: Woolfall - Pet Trailer | Cute Pets in a Co-op Sheep Mining Sandbox | Wishlist on Steam
snippet.description:
Pets get bored. And when they get bored, they get up to no good.

Wishlist Woolfall on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5541530/Woolfall/

Woolfall is a co-op sandbox where you dig a mine, fill it with sheep and watch it go wrong. Along the way you find pets: a sheepdog puppy that herds the others, a hedgehog that rolls off as a ball, an alpaca that spits, a canary that faints at gas, a chicken whose egg hatches, and more. Thirteen in all, each with its own jokes, and in co-op they meet your friends' pets, for better or worse.

🐑 Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players
⛏️ Dig, flood, burn and blow up everything under the grass
🐾 13 pets to find, each with a mind of its own
📅 Coming 2027 to PC (Steam)

Gameplay trailer: https://youtu.be/JRly3_Mj7mE
Website: https://vindrgames.com

#Woolfall #IndieGame #PixelArt
